note: Montserrat: a work permit from the Labour Department, applied for by the employer and approved by Cabinet (Immigration Act, Cap. 13.01); OECS citizens need none (the oecs list). No days without it. British citizens and the other territories' passports, though of the same nationality, need it too and are named; the territory's own are home.

sources.title: Government of Montserrat, Services: Finding A Job (Need A Work Permit?)
sources.said: NEED A WORK PERMIT? ... Click below to apply for a work permit or to renew your work permit: ... Processing Fee for CARICOM National=EC$75.00; OTHERS=$125.00
